column1: # Verdicts of the SHELL git-guard.sh, frozen at the commit that replaced
# it with the Go port. blocked<TAB>command, tabs and newlines escaped.
# This is the boundary, not a convenience: once the shell implementation
# is deleted its behaviour is unrecoverable, and a security guard whose
# only spec is its own source can drift in either direction — a hole or a
# false refusal — with nothing to notice. Regenerating this file is not a
# way to make a failing test pass. A row that legitimately changes gets
# edited by hand, in a commit that says why.
